manifest.licence_basis: Standard-library set arithmetic implemented in this release.
manifest.limitations: Coverage of unique matching identifiers in these supplied record snapshots. Missing evidence or an unmatched identifier is not a negative biological observation. Linking across identifier namespaces requires an explicit mapping upstream. Coverage does not measure annotation quality or independence.

method_card.estimator: Distinct cohort IDs after outer whitespace normalization, case-sensitive; all cohort IDs without a located evidence value remain in scope.
method_card.mechanism: Join cohort.record_key to evidence.record_key and count each ID with a nonempty pmcid once.
method_card.objective: How many declared cohort IDs have evidence?
method_card.training_data_lineage: Source SHA256 and exact line/quote in method-spec.json; independent local arithmetic.
